## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: weak breadth (≤4) plus negative Risk Score (-3) vs mildly positive Cycle (+1), and a major divergence across large caps; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads: TSLA (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND, GM (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: EL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.11%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities/Communication showing short-term bid: AEP (1W: +1.27% | 1M: -5.04%) RECOVERY, TMUS (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -4.74%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -11.35% | 1M: -6.07%) BELOW TREND. Energy weak: VLO (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -9.63%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate under pressure; Financials mixed despite some big winners.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.11%) ABOVE TREND; TSLA (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND; COF (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +19.96%) ABOVE TREND; GM (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND; BMY (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +16.47%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NOW (1W: -11.35% | 1M: -6.07%) BELOW TREND; AVGO (1W: -8.35% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -5.23% | 1M: -20.17%) BELOW TREND; AMD (1W: -4.61% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in big-cap Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: TSLA (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND; EL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.11%) ABOVE TREND; COF (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +19.96%) ABOVE TREND; TMUS (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -4.74%) RECOVERY; TGT (1W: +2.02% | 1M: +15.07%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence across large caps (AAPL, GOOGL, JPM, V, MA with 1W vs 1M mismatches) — tactical caution.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak and internally rotating with large-cap leadership dispersion; NOW (1W: -11.35% | 1M: -6.07%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -8.35% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.14% | 1M: -0.46%) RECOVERY, AAPL (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +1.35%) CORRECTION — Sector 1W: -2.48%.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed: COF (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +19.96%) ABOVE TREND, USB (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +3.21%) CORRECTION and key card names V (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +6.75%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -1.00% | 1M: +6.76%) CORRECTION — sector 1W: -0.88% and internally mixed.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed/defensive: BMY (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +16.47%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +0.69%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +2.10% | 1M: -4.58%) RECOVERY, JNJ (1W: -1.55% | 1M: +3.52%) CORRECTION — sector 1W: -0.13% and showing selective strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Consumer Discretionary and Staples winners (TSLA, EL) and high-momentum Financials (COF, USB); reduce exposure to large-cap Technology names showing BELOW TREND (NVDA, ORCL, AVGO). Given CAUTION and major divergences, emphasize selectivity and monitor trend confirmation before adding risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: TSLA (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.11%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +19.96%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NOW (1W: -11.35% | 1M: -6.07%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -5.23% | 1M: -20.17%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +9.54%) and Utilities/Communication showing short-term support (breadth positive). BEARISH: Technology and Energy (1W: -2.48% and -3.88% respectively) where multiple large caps are BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch TSLA sustaining the weekly breakout to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; NVDA must reclaim its 1M range to reverse BELOW TREND pressure; AAPL needs to hold its 1M support to avoid deeper CORRECTION; NOW failing to stabilize would deepen Technology downside.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership. TSLA (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND and EL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.11%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among large caps (AAPL, GOOGL, JPM, V, MA) — watch for trend breaks before increasing exposure.
